```yaml
name: Release Ollama Provider Support for v1.0

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v1.0'

jobs:
  restore-ollama-support:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Add Ollama to provider registry
        run: |
          echo "export const ollama = { name: 'Ollama', url: 'https://api.ollama.ai' }" >> lib/utils/registry.ts

      - name: Update model configuration system
        run: |
          sed -i 's/"provider": "openai"/"provider": ["openai", "ollama"]/' src/config.ts

      - name: Update documentation
        run: |
          echo "- Ollama: A privacy-conscious AI provider." >> README.md
          echo "  - Supports organizations with data sovereignty requirements." >> README.md
          echo "  - Enables development without API costs." >> README.md
          echo "  - Allows users in regions with limited API access." >> README.md

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git add .
          git commit -m "Restore Ollama Provider Support for v1.0"

      - name: Push changes
        run: git push origin HEAD:v1.0
```
